verdict.rationale: Passkey support is a fair question for an authenticator and password-manager suite, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack mentions passkeys or WebAuthn: 2FAS Auth documents only TOTP, HOTP and Steam Guard codes, and 2FAS Pass documents password Items and Autofill. Those are adjacent features, not passkey storage or passkey sign-in.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app stores passkeys and signs me into websites and apps with them, not just TOTP codes
